asset.name: Presence
asset.description: The mount and unmount lifecycle primitive letting content animate out before removal, handling interruption, nesting, and reduced-motion collapse.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.

rationale: The base of the entire motion domain. Every other motion asset delegates its lifecycle here, which is what makes the kit's transition classes apply uniformly instead of per component.
